text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: embedding-similarity-drop detected for model `redwood-embed-v3` in prod (us-west). Signal: `embed-sim-down` >= 14% vs baseline. Affected routes: /search, /kg-retrieval. Runbook: https://runbooks/internal/embed-regression

carla: noticed spike on dashboards at 12:02 PDT, retrieval precision for a couple customers dropped ~12-16%. latency +120ms on average. Opening thread.

mike: taking oncall. tagging @sre-jess. initial hypothesis: new weightset deployed 23:58 -> possible tokenizer/quant mismatch or config drift.

sre-jess: looking at node logs, seeing warnings: `KV cache miss rate elevated` and `attention-kernel: fallback to float32`. Might be quant mismatch. Can handle routing rollback if needed.

mike: preparing immediate mitigation: flip feature flag to stop routing to v3, route to `redwood-embed-v1` (stable). Flipping now.

mike: ```bash
curl -X POST "https://flags.internal/api/toggle" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"flag":"embed-v3-rollout","value":false,"actor":"mike"}'
```

deploy-bot: feature-flag update queued -> feature=embed-v3-rollout, value=false, actor=mike
deploy-bot: feature-flag update applied (sha=abcd1234, env=prod, region=us-west) :white_check_mark:

eng-ben: starting routing revert, will change routing policy TTL to 30s to shift traffic away from v3. exec: `routectl revert --policy embed_v3 --target embed_v1 --region us-west`

support-ana: receiving customer pings on search degradations, ticket ids: INC-8710, INC-8711. Marking customer-impacting.

carla: setting severity P1 due to customer-facing relevance drop. Pager notified. Handoff: mike -> sre-jess after initial cut.

mike: routing change propagated, traffic to embed-v3 now <2% in us-west. Observability: similarity metrics recovering: +9% within 3m of flip, latency down ~80ms.

sre-jess: monitoring traces and cache warmup. No errors from v1. Will keep watch for 30m.

carla: collecting artifacts for postmortem: deploy artifact id=embed-v3:2026-03-17:sha=abcd1234, tokenizer package=tokenizer-v2.4. Logs and diffs saved to incident ticket. Runbook link: https://runbooks/internal/embed-regression

mike: leaving the thread, handing to @sre-jess for monitoring and follow-ups. I will stay available for rollback if we see further regressions. :thumbsup:

sre-jess: acknowledged. I'll keep the pager open for 45m and escalate if metrics slip.

carla: incident declared resolved for live traffic after stabilization. Will capture timeline and ETA for production postmortem. If anyone sees reversion, re-open pager. :eyes:
